load_sonata_model: load a pretrained sonata model checkpoint from HuggingFace or local path
build_point_transformer_v3: build a PointTransformerV3 model with configurable encoder-decoder architecture for 3D point cloud processing
create_serialized_attention: create serialized attention module with optional flash attention for efficient point cloud transformer blocks
run_point_transformer_forward: run a forward pass of the sonata point transformer on a point cloud data dictionary
test_grid_pooling_unpooling: test grid pooling and unpooling operations for hierarchical point cloud feature aggregation and upsampling
